name: Action Items to To Do
description: Watches your Teams chats, meeting transcripts, and Outlook mail for things people actually asked you to do, and files each one as a Microsoft To Do task with a due date, priority, and source link.
author: Matteo Pagani
coverImageAlt: Warm paper messages and an audio waveform converge through cyan paths into an organized priority checklist.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: an editorial visual metaphor for incoming communication being distilled into a clear, prioritized action list
Scene/backdrop: a deep slate workbench field with warm paper message fragments and transcript ribbons converging into one orderly task panel
Subject: three abstract communication streams flow through a precise cyan organizing path into a short stack of clean checklist cards, with one restrained orange priority marker; use shapes only, not readable interface elements
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional paper, subtle beveled depth, and restrained technical precision
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; centered crop-safe focal subject; balanced negative space; no essential detail in the outer 8%
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical, with a controlled cyan backlight and soft warm-paper highlights
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI, Microsoft Fluent branding, or rainbow gradient
